---
title: Genetic Algorithm (GA) for Variable Selection
format: gfm
---

```{python}
#| include: false
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from GA import select
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
```

```{python}
df = pd.read_csv("baseball.dat", sep=r"\s+")
y = np.log(df["salary"])          
X = df.drop(columns=["salary"])   
scaler = StandardScaler()
X_scaled = scaler.fit_transform(X)
```

```{python}
select(X_scaled, y,model_type="linear",penalty=0.01)
```

```{python}
lasso_params = {
    "alpha": 0.1,
    "max_iter": 5000,
    "tol": 1e-4,
    "random_state": 42
}

select(X_scaled, y,model_type="lasso",model_params=lasso_params,penalty=0.01)
```



```{python}
select(X_scaled, y,model_type="linear",n_gen=30)
```

```{python}
select(X_scaled, y,model_type="linear",parent_selection="tournament",crossover_type="double",n_gen=30)
```




```{python}
df = pd.read_csv("employees.csv")
df_clean = df.dropna() 
y_em = df_clean["satisfaction_level"]
X_em = df_clean.drop(columns=["satisfaction_level"])

select(X_em, y_em)
```

```{python}
df = pd.read_csv("employees.csv")
df_clean = df.dropna() 
y_em = df_clean["satisfaction_level"]
X_em = df_clean.drop(columns=["satisfaction_level"])

select(X_em, y_em,model_type="tree")
```
